name: Dependency & Component Analysis
description: Analysis of third-party dependencies and open-source components for known vulnerabilities, license risks, and malicious packages. Covers SCA tool operation, vulnerability database correlation, transitive dependency analysis, and risk-based prioritization of dependency findings.

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands software supply chain risks and dependency management
evidence: Can explain the risks of third-party dependencies (known vulnerabilities, malicious packages)
Familiar with package managers (npm, pip, Maven, NuGet) and lock files
Understands CVE databases and vulnerability scoring (CVSS)

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Runs SCA tools under supervision and reviews basic findings
evidence: Executed dependency scans using tools (Snyk, OWASP Dependency-Check, Trivy)
Identified known vulnerable dependencies in lab projects
Reviewed transitive dependency trees for risk assessment
Work reviewed by authorized analyst

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently analyzes dependencies and produces risk-prioritized reports
evidence: Independently performed dependency analysis on 5+ engagements
Correlates findings with NVD/OSV and assesses exploitability in context
Identifies reachability of vulnerable code paths in dependencies
Produces prioritized remediation guidance based on risk and exploitability
Passed proficiency assessment on dependency analysis

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Handles complex dependency ecosystems; detects malicious packages
evidence: Identifies dependency confusion and typosquatting risks
Evaluates package maintainer trustworthiness and project health metrics
Develops custom policies for dependency governance
Mentors junior analysts on dependency analysis methodology

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Authority on software composition analysis; develops lab standards
evidence: Published research on supply chain vulnerabilities or malicious packages
Developed the lab's SCA methodology and governance framework
Discovered malicious packages or dependency-based attack vectors
Trains teams on advanced dependency analysis

assessment_methods.description: Analyze a project with complex dependencies, identify vulnerabilities, assess reachability, and produce a prioritized risk report
Review of dependency analysis findings and prioritization from 3 recent engagements

work_roles: OG-WRL-017 Cybersecurity Supply Chain Risk Management
